public_rationale: There is evidence of model limitations, conditional mathematical constraints and concerns about Altman's technical expertise. These facts do not establish the asserted causal chain. OpenAI also documented improvements, so continuing limitations cannot fairly be treated as evidence that it had made no progress.
limitations: Public reporting provides limited access to internal technical decisions.
Personal expertise and organizational research capacity are different questions.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Despite his connections and funding, Sam Altman still can't get past these obvious problems, partly because he isn't technical and so can't really solve them himself, and partly because the problems are burdened by the laws of mathematics and physics.
conditions: despite being the most well-connected and well-funded man in AI

statement.excerpt: and he still can’t get past any of these very obvious problems, partly because he isn’t technical and thus can’t really solve any of the problems himself, and partly because the problems he’s facing are burdened by the laws of mathematics and physics.

from_speaker: still can’t get past any of these very obvious problems
can’t really solve any of the problems himself
burdened by the laws of mathematics and physics
our_interpretation: Assess the explanation for OpenAI's limitations as of May 13, 2024, rather than a prediction that improvement is impossible.
The surrounding discussion identifies reliability, computational expense, energy requirements and video-generation limitations.
Read 'isn’t technical' as lacking the expertise to personally solve these research and engineering problems, rather than never having programmed.
Support requires evidence connecting Altman's expertise to the persistence of the limitations. Their coexistence is insufficient.
The references to funding and connections are background to the causal claim, not a separate financial ranking.
criteria.support_condition: Technical analyses and development records establish that the identified limitations persisted, and that both Altman's limited technical expertise and specified mathematical or physical constraints materially contributed.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Development records or technical findings directly refute the proposed causal links, or establish that the identified limitations had already been overcome.

evidence.excerpt: it still is not fully reliable
evidence.explanation: OpenAI acknowledged reliability problems while also reporting reduced hallucination relative to earlier models. This establishes neither their persistence for the asserted reasons nor an absence of progress.

evidence.publisher: arXiv; Adam Tauman Kalai and Santosh S. Vempala
evidence.explanation: The paper establishes a statistical lower bound for certain arbitrary facts under a calibration condition, while allowing mitigation for other errors. It does not establish a general physical barrier or a causal role for Altman.

evidence.excerpt: misusing or confusing basic technical terms
evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Altman is not a technical savant'
evidence.explanation: Original reporting lends weight to concerns about his technical expertise. The recollections are not precisely dated and do not show that his expertise caused the limitations described in May 2024.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Dated development records identifying how Altman's technical involvement affected particular unresolved problems, together with technical analyses establishing or refuting the claimed fundamental constraints.
